name: commander
description: Run one long-lived Claude Code session as a commander over other named sessions: see who is up and what they are doing (/commander:roll-call), hand work to the right session with a self-contained brief and a reply contract (/commander:dispatch), check every client's day plan in one command before any task goes out (/commander:plan-check), nudge workers that sit idle with work open (/commander:nudge), push to the operator's phone when a worker or a question waits too long (/commander:notify), get a recommendation to open another session when work could run in parallel (/commander:scale), and ask the owner through Atlas without stopping any session, with answers and messages between agents delivered across machines and Claude accounts (/commander:ask)
